source.title: U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service — Where do polar bears live?

literal.prompt: Какое из перечисленных животных в природе обитает в Арктике, а не в Антарктике?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: FWS explicitly places polar bears in Northern Hemisphere Arctic sea-ice seas. Three independently named AAP species have Antarctic breeding/coastal distributions. The question asks natural geography; no captivity context. Only slot 0 answers Arctic rather than Antarctic.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Это белый медведь. Он обитает среди покрытых льдом морей Арктики, а остальные варианты относятся к видам, размножающимся или живущим у побережья Антарктиды.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Arctic ice-covered-sea habitat follows FWS. AAP supports Antarctic coastal life or breeding for the other species. The disjunction living or breeding avoids claiming year-round terrestrial residence or exclusively continental range.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Белый медведь использует морской лёд как платформу для охоты на тюленей.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: FWS explicitly identifies sea ice as a hunting and feeding platform for seals. This functional hunting fact adds information beyond the MAIN geographic choice.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Императорские пингвины образуют колонии на морском припайном льду вокруг Антарктиды.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: AAP states colonies occur around Antarctica and most lie on fast ice. The generic statement describes that established pattern; it does not say every colony, always or only fast ice. It does not make this species Arctic.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Тюлени Уэдделла — прибрежные обитатели Антарктики; они выходят на припайный лёд отдыхать и размножаться.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Coastal Antarctic distribution and fast-ice resting are supported. Broad reproduction on the haul-out ice blurs the source distinction between females pupping on ice and observed underwater mating; name pupping precisely.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Пингвины Адели гнездятся вдоль побережья Антарктиды и на небольших островах с открытыми скалами.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: AAP gives breeding along the Antarctic coast and small islands where exposed rock is available. Nesting is a breeding-season claim; the article separately describes winter at sea and pack ice.

absoluteLevel.ground: A broad adult can identify the white bear as Arctic rather than Antarctic without specialist seal taxonomy or breeding knowledge. The one familiar positive choice suffices; all distractors remain plausible polar fauna.

taxonomyAndAntiOverlap.ground: MAIN asks polar geographic range, a substantive Arctic-versus-Antarctic distinction. Animals hunting, morphology, classification and breeding mechanism questions test different relations; this is not merely an animal-name wrapper.

correctNoteExtraFact.ground: Functional use of sea ice is additional to region. Overlap with Animals 9 hunting MAIN is allowed note-to-MAIN overlap and is not a duplicate of this MAIN.

defects.finding: The phrase «выходят на припайный лёд … размножаться» can suggest mating on ice. The full species context distinguishes females giving birth on fast ice from an observed mating under water. This is a precision defect, not a second correct answer or a claim that birth is unrelated to reproduction.
defects.requestedSourceCycle: Clarify the ice activity as resting and females giving birth to pups (moulting is also supported). Preserve species, geography, key, order and easy. Return one directed source cycle; no edit by this reader.
